title: LegacyResponse
description: Legacy MIF REST (maxrest) JSON serialisation (_format=json). The serializer wraps records in a Query<OS>Response (os) or <MBO>MboSet (mbo) envelope carrying rsStart/rsCount/rsTotal; field names are upper-case MBO attributes. Exact nesting is serializer-configurable (mxe.rest.serializer.*) and not specified field by field here.
